hero.subtitle: Daily predictions, pre-tournament picks, live leaderboard — everything your office needs for the World Cup.

matchPredictions.title: Match Predictions
matchPredictions.desc: Pick the exact score for every match. Predictions lock automatically at kickoff. The closer you are, the more points you earn.

preCup.title: Pre-Cup Picks
preCup.desc: Choose the champion, the shame pick (top-14 team eliminated earliest), and the surprise pick before the World Cup starts.

liveLeaderboard.title: Live Leaderboard
liveLeaderboard.desc: Real-time ranking with automatic scoring. Updates every 30 seconds. Podium for the top 3.

everyonePredictions.title: See Everyone's Picks
everyonePredictions.desc: After kickoff, see what everyone in the office predicted. Who nailed the score? Who made the boldest call?

phaseMultipliers.title: Phase Multipliers
phaseMultipliers.desc: Points are worth more in knockout rounds. Group stage ×1, round of 16 ×1.25, quarterfinals ×1.5, semifinals ×1.75, final ×3.

export.title: Export to Power BI
export.desc: Export leaderboard CSVs to build custom dashboards. Clean data ready for analysis.

createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.desc: Sign up in seconds. No payment details needed — the pool is free.

makePredictions.title: Make your predictions
makePredictions.desc: Pick each match score before kickoff. Choose your pre-cup picks before June 11.

followLeaderboard.title: Follow the leaderboard
followLeaderboard.desc: Points are calculated automatically after every match. Whoever has the most points at the end wins.

scoring.title: How points
scoring.phaseMultiplier: Multiplied by phase: Groups ×1 · Round of 16 ×1.25 · Quarterfinals ×1.5 · Semifinals ×1.75 · Final ×3
scoring.preCupNote: Shame and Surprise use the FIFA index × phase factor for tiebreakers

finalCta.title: Ready to
finalCta.subtitle: Invite the team, make your predictions, and track who is the office's best prediction expert.
